goal: Allow running txindex alongside block pruning so users with limited disk space can index transactions
Enable lookups for pruned transactions to return block hashes that can be fetched on demand
reviewability: Ready to review; CI is passing and earlier reviewer feedback has been addressed
agreement: Strong concept support across multiple reviewers with no objections
Useful for running local block-explorer setups with bounded disk usage (ajtowns)
Valuable for locating pruned blocks and fetching them on demand (arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it removes a long-standing restriction preventing txindex from running with block pruning
Enables resource-constrained node operators to index transactions and find historical blocks on demand

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it only adds minor context and candidate block hashes when transaction lookups fail due to pruning
Benefit is limited to error responses and exposing the index starting height in getindexinfo
